segments.title: April
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! April is our birthday month. Nine years of Physique 57, and the theme is Cloud Nine: a party in four acts, eight offers, and more confetti than is strictly sensible.

segments.title: ₹15.1L
segments.text: So, the number. Our April target for Kenkere House is 15.1 lakh rupees. That's 24 per cent above last April. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 8 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 5.13 lakh, everything else 1.06 lakh, and comebacks 90,600. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 76 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 1128 leads, 406 trials, and 76 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Seven offers carry 9.36 lakh rupees, which is 62 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Moving In Together (The 9-Month Lease)
segments.text: First up, Moving In Together, the nine-month lease. Nine months unlimited, nine freezes, the anniversary hoodie and a numbered brass key. That's 2 buyers, for 2.06 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members ready for a long commitment and returning clients who want the best price of the year.

segments.title: The 9:09 Panic Attack
segments.text: Next, the nine-oh-nine panic attack. The limited nine-class pack. That's 8 buyers, for 61,600 rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: members, pack buyers and newcomers.

segments.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
segments.text: Then, Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend who joins and get nine extra days. That's 4 buyers, for 49,600 rupees.
segments.notes: Current members bringing a never-been friend.

segments.title: Party Crasher Pass
segments.text: Also this month, for newcomers, the Party Crasher Pass. Three classes for nine ninety-nine, party class included, credited against a first month. That's 9 buyers, for 1.05 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
segments.text: After that, for lapsed members, Faking Your Own Death Didn't Work. They get an obituary postcard, which is also their ticket to the candle-lit Séance Class. That's 8 buyers, for 99,200 rupees.

segments.title: Spin Class (Literally)
segments.text: Next, for renewals, Spin Class. Literally. Renew in April and spin the Wheel of Nine. That's 22 buyers, for 2.89 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.

segments.title: Club Nine: The Founders’ Table
segments.text: And finally, Club Nine, the Founders' Table. Nine numbered annual seats per studio, with the perks doubled: four privates, eight guest passes, priority booking all year and a numbered jacket. That's 1 buyer, for 1.25 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members on 3-Month or longer plans; annual renewers.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Platinum Hour, the launch film, and the numbered keys go live with a public counter. Week two, anniversary week: the wheel, the plank-off, Barre-stie day and the nine-oh-nine panic attack. Week three, obituary postcards, the Séance Class, the Club Nine unveiling and nine at nine on the eighteenth. Week four, the Throwback Reunion, the Golden Glute Awards, and a midnight lock-in on the thirtieth.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's April at Kenkere House. 15.1 lakh rupees, seven offers, and 76 buyers to welcome. Nine years in, and honestly? We've never looked better.
